C1668.title: Webhook Forgery on Zendesk Trigger in n8n
C1668.summary: The Zendesk trigger node in the n8n platform contains a webhook forgery vulnerability. Once an attacker knows the webhook URL, they can send unsigned POST requests with arbitrary data to trigger workflows. The node fails to validate the HMAC-SHA256 signature appended by Zendesk, allowing any party to inject forged Zendesk event payloads and trigger sensitive operations within automated workflows.
